Public and Private Market Research and Data Across Australia

INTRODUCING AUSTRALIAN PUBLIC AND PRIVATE MARKET RESEARCH & DATA

Real assets are complex. Underwriting them doesn’t have to be.
{{$unifiedIndividual.ssot__PersonName__c}},
When the stakes are high the world's top lenders, asset managers, and investors leverage Green Street’s insights to make capital allocation decisions and generate alpha.

Now that same standard extends to Australian private markets. Market grades, net initial yield and commercial property price indexes, rental growth forecasts, return expectations and sales comparables.
Request a Demo
Assess value and underwrite with greater conviction.
Just launched: Coverage across industrial, office, and retail for ‘B/B+’ quality assets in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth, and Adelaide, with ‘A/A+’ quality insight.

  • Deeper supply and demand analysis with statistically back-tested market grading framework behind long-term growth rates, supporting terminal value underwriting.
  • IRRs enabling relative return comparisons across markets in Australia and globally, on an apples-to-apples basis. 
  • Full forecasting models with two decades of history, from headline market rent, commercial property price and net initial yield indexes through to M-RevPAM and NOI growth.
  • Real-time and extensive sales comps, analyst-verified with price, location, size, and the buyer, seller, and broker details.
  • Independent research providing pricing signals on Australian public and private market real estate.

The result: a more complete, more comparable view of relative value – enabling clients to underwrite with confidence.
Make sharper capital allocation decisions with independent research, data and exclusive news.
